capability.summary: Forward-geocode a place query with Nominatim
capability.description: Searches Nominatim with required q, fixed format=json, and limit=3. Despite the legacy artifact label, the wrapper returns a JSON array of search objects rather than GeoJSON. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Place-name to coordinate lookup; not reverse geocoding, map rendering, routing, or address verification.

constraint.io_signature: Input: q at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Nominatim JSON result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one place, address, or free-form geocoding query
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search with format=json and limit=3
API caps the requested result count at three; wrapper does not further truncate or paginate
usage policy, rate limits, and result quality are external; no cache or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing up to three Nominatim search objects, URL, and HTTP status.

negative_intents: calculate a route or render a map
